verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants and agents run broad finance operations through natural-language requests, without opening the Jeeves app. Covered operations include asking about card spend, paying vendors, pulling statements, issuing and adjusting cards, querying and exporting transactions, and submitting reimbursements. This natural-language operation depends on an external AI assistant connecting through MCP, and no built-in natural-language interface is documented. Missing for 10: a native first-party natural-language command interface, independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described, and documentation of natural-language coverage beyond the listed MCP tool areas.
